Encryption._comment: Dev-only default, public (it's in the repo) - override via env var/user-secrets before storing anything real. Must match ColdNet.Admin's key. See docs/ENCRYPTION.md.

ModuleSigning._comment: Every module assembly (built-in and plugins/) must carry a valid detached signature from the trusted public certificate, or the host refuses to start. See docs/MODULE-SIGNING.md.
